verses.uthmani: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
verses.indopak: اِقْتَـرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
verses.transliteration: ﻿iqtarabati alssa'atu wainshaqqa alqamaru
verses.saheeh: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
verses.khattab: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Hour has drawn near, the Resurrection is close at hand, and the moon has split, it broke in two at [Mount] Abū Qubays and Qu‘ayqa‘ān, as a sign for the Prophet (s), for it had been demanded of him, and [when it took place] he said, ‘Bear witness [now]!’ — as reported by the two Shaykhs [al-Bukhārī and Muslim].
verses.romanUrdu: Qayamat ki ghadi kareeb aa gayi aur chaand phatt (split) gaya

verses.uthmani: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةٗ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٞ مُّسۡتَمِرّٞ
verses.indopak: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا اٰيَةً يُّعْرِضُوْا وَيَقُوْلُوْا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.transliteration: wain yaraw ayatan yu'ridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
verses.saheeh: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
verses.khattab: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if they, the disbelievers among Quraysh, see a sign, a miracle of the Prophet (s), they turn away and say, this is: ‘A powerful sorcery!’ (mustamirr, ‘powerful’, derives from al-mirra, meaning ‘strength’; or it [mustamirr] means ‘incessant’).
verses.romanUrdu: Magar in logon ka haal yeh hai ke khwa koi nishani dekh lein mooh moadh jaatey hain aur kehte hain yeh to chalta hua jaadu hai

verses.uthmani: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.indopak: وَكَذَّبُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَاۤءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ اَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.transliteration: wakaththaboo waittaba'oo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
verses.saheeh: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
verses.khattab: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they denied, the Prophet (s), and followed their own desires, as regards [their] falsehood; and every matter, that is good or evil, will be settled, with that person [who is responsible for it], either [by his ending up] in Paradise or in the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Inhon ne (isko bhi) jhutla diya aur apni khwahishat-e-nafs hi ki pairwi ki.Har maamlay ko Aakhir-e-kaar ek anjaam par pahunch kar rehna hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنْۢبَاۤءِ مَا فِيْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
verses.saheeh: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
verses.khattab: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily there has come to them such tidings, stories about the destruction of communities which denied their messengers, as contain a deterrent, to them (muzdajar is a verbal noun, or a noun of place; the dāl [of muzdajar] replaces the tā’ of [the 8th form] ifta‘ala; one may say, izdajartuhu or zajartuhu, to mean ‘I forbade him sternly’; mā, ‘such as’, either indicates a relative clause, or it is qualified by an adjective);
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ke saamne (pichle qaumon ke) woh halaat aa chuke hain jinmein sarkashi se baaz rakhne ke liye kafi samaan-e-ibrat hai

verses.uthmani: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞ ۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.indopak: حِكْمَةٌ  ۢ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
verses.saheeh: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
verses.khattab: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿wisdom (hikmatun is the predicate of an omitted subject, or a substitution for mā, ‘such as’, or for muzdajar, ‘deterrent’) [that is] far-reaching, complete; but warnings (nudhur is the plural of nadhīr, functioning in the [agent] sense of mundhir, ‘a warner’, that is to say, ‘those matters which warn them’; mā is either for negation, or it is an interrogative of denial, in which case it stands as a preceding direct object) are of no avail, [warnings] are of no use with them.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aisi hikmat jo nasihat ke maqsad ko ba-darja-e-atam (consummate wisdom) pura karti hain magar tambihat(warnings) in par kaargar nahin hoti

verses.uthmani: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ ۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ نُّكُرٍ
verses.indopak: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰى شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: fatawalla 'anhum yawma yad'u aldda'i ila shayin nukurin
verses.saheeh: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
verses.khattab: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So turn away from them! (this is the import of the preceding statement and it completes what is being said). On the day when the Summoner, namely, Isrāfīl (yawma, ‘the day’, is rendered accusative by yakhrujūna, ‘they will emerge’, next [verse]), summons to an awful thing (read nukur or nukr, in the sense of munkar, ‘disagreeable’), [a thing] which the souls will find awful, and this is the Reckoning;
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey Nabi, insey rukh pher lo. Jis roz pukarne wala ek sakht nagawaar cheez ki taraf pukarega

verses.uthmani: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
verses.indopak: خُشَّعًا اَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنْتَشِرٌ ۙ
verses.transliteration: khushsha'an absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
verses.saheeh: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
verses.khattab: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts
verses.jalalayn: ﻿with their downcast (khāshi‘an: a variant reading has khushsha‘an), humiliated, looks (absāruhum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb [yakhrujūna, ‘they will emerge’]) they, that is, mankind, will emerge from the graves as though they were scattered locusts, not knowing where to go, out of fear and perplexity (this sentence [ka’annahum jarādun muntashirun] is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of [the verb] yakhrujūna, ‘they will emerge’, and so is His saying [muhti‘īna]),
verses.romanUrdu: Log sehmi hui (down-cast) nigaahon ke saath apni qabraon se is tarah niklenge goya woh bikhri huyi tiddiyan (locusts) hain

verses.uthmani: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٞ
verses.indopak: مُّهْطِعِيْنَ اِلَى الدَّاعِ ۗ يَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.transliteration: muhti'eena ila aldda'i yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun 'asirun
verses.saheeh: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
verses.khattab: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿scrambling, hastening with their necks stretched out, toward the Summoner. The disbelievers, among them, will say: ‘This is a hard day!’, a difficult one for disbelievers — as is stated in [sūrat] al-Muddaththir, a day of hardship for the disbelievers [Q. 74:9-10].
verses.romanUrdu: Pukarne wale ki taraf daudey jaa rahey hongey Aur wahi munkireen (jo duniya mein iska inkar karte thay)us waqt kahenge ke yeh din to bada kathin hai

verses.uthmani: ۞ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونٞ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
verses.indopak: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ فَكَذَّبُوْا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْا مَجْنُوْنٌ وَّازْدُجِرَ
verses.transliteration: kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo 'abdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
verses.saheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
verses.khattab: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The people of Noah denied (kadhdhabat has feminine inflection on account of the import [referring to a feminine noun], qawm, ‘tribe’) before them, before Quraysh. Thus they denied Our servant, Noah, and said, ‘A madman!’, and he was reviled: they repulsed him with insults and in other ways.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey pehle Nooh ki qaum jhutla chuki hai. Unhon ne hamare bandey ko jhoota karar diya aur kaha ke yeh deewana hai, aur woh buri tarah jhidka (rebuffed) gaya

verses.uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
verses.indopak: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗۤ اَنِّىْ مَغْلُوْبٌ فَانْـتَصِرْ
verses.transliteration: fada'a rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
verses.saheeh: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
verses.khattab: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And so he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘I have been (annī, to be understood as bi-annī) overcome, so help [me]!’
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir-e-kaar usne apne Rubb ko pukara ke “main magloob ho chuka , ab tu inse inteqam le”

verses.uthmani: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٖ مُّنۡهَمِرٖ
verses.indopak: فَفَتَحْنَاۤ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَاۤءِ بِمَاۤءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ ۖ
verses.transliteration: fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
verses.saheeh: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
verses.khattab: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We opened (read fa-fatahnā or fa-fattahnā) the gates of the heaven with torrential waters, [waters] pouring down intensely,
verses.romanUrdu: Tab humne mausla-dhaar baarish se aasmaan ke darwaze khol diye aur zameen ko phaad kar chasmon mein tabdeel kar diya

verses.uthmani: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونٗا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرٖ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
verses.indopak: وَّفَجَّرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُيُوْنًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاۤءُ عَلٰۤى اَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: wafajjarna alarda 'uyoonan failtaqa almao 'ala amrin qad qudira
verses.saheeh: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
verses.khattab: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and We made the earth burst forth with springs, that flowed forth, and the waters, the waters of the heaven and the earth, met for a purpose, a circumstance, that was preordained, [a matter] which had been decreed since pre-eternity, namely, their destruction by drowning.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh saara paani us kaam ko pura karne ke liye mil gaya jo mukaddar ho chuka tha

verses.uthmani: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحٖ وَدُسُرٖ
verses.indopak: وَحَمَلْنٰهُ عَلٰى ذَاتِ اَلْوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wahamalnahu 'ala thati alwahin wadusurin
verses.saheeh: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
verses.khattab: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We bore him, that is, Noah, on one, a ship, [made] of planks and nails (dusur is what boards are fastened down with of nails and the like; the singular is disār, similar [in pattern] to [kutub] kitāb, ‘book’),
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Nooh ko humne ek takhaton(planks) aur keelon (nails) wali par sawar kar diya

verses.uthmani: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءٗ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.indopak: تَجْرِىْ بِاَعْيُنِنَا ۚ جَزَاۤءً لِّمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.transliteration: tajree bia'yunina jazaan liman kana kufira
verses.saheeh: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
verses.khattab: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied
verses.jalalayn: ﻿sailing before Our eyes, that is, in Our sights, in other words, [it was being] protected, as retaliation (jazā’an is in the accusative because of the implied verbal clause, that is to say, ‘they were drowned by way of revenge’) for [the sake of] him who was rejected, namely, Noah, peace be upon him (a variant reading [for passive kufira] has kafara, ‘him who disbelieved’, in other words, they were drowned as a punishment for them).
verses.romanUrdu: Jo hamari nigrani mein chal rahi thi .yeh tha badla us shaks ki khatir jiski na-qadri ki gayi thi

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةٗ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ تَّرَكْنٰهَاۤ اٰيَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We left it, We preserved this [deed], as a sign, for whomever might be admonished by it, in other words, the news of this [deed] became widely-known and endured. So is there anyone who will remember?, [anyone who] will take heed from, or be admonished by, it? (muddakir is actually mudhtakir, but the tā’ has been replaced with a dāl, likewise the dhāl, and it [the dāl] has been assimilated with it [the other dāl]).
verses.romanUrdu: Us kashti ko humne ek nishani bana kar chodh diya, phir koi hai nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kana 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿How [dreadful] then were My chastisement and My warnings? (this is an interrogative meant as an affirmative; kayfa, ‘how’, is the predicate of kāna, ‘was’, and it is here being used to inquire about a ‘state’; the intention is to prompt those who are being addressed to affirm the fact that God’s chastisement of those who denied Noah was fully deserved).
verses.romanUrdu: Dekhlo, kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have made the Qur'an easy to remember, We have facilitated its memorisation and disposed it to serve as a [source of] remembrance. So is there anyone who remember?, [anyone who] will be admonished by it and memorise it? (the interrogative here is intended as an imperative: in other words, memorise it and be admonished by it; none of God’s scriptures is memorised by heart other than it [the Qur'an]).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, phir kya hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٞ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: kaththabat 'adun fakayfa kana 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.khattab: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘Ād denied, their prophet Hūd and so they were chastised. How then were My chastisement and My warnings?, [how then was] My warning them of the chastisement before it was sent down? In other words, it was justified, and He explains this [chastisement] by saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Aad ne jhutlaya, to dekhlo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٖ مُّسۡتَمِرّٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِىْ يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna arsalna 'alayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We unleashed upon them a clamorous wind, intensely noisy, on a day of prolonged ill fortune, (nahsin mustamirr means) either one of continuous ill fortune, or one of severe ill fortune — and this was the last Wednesday of the month —
verses.romanUrdu: Humne ek paiham nahusat (unremitting misfortune) ke din sakht toofani hawa unpar bhej di jo logon ko utha utha kar is tarah phenk rahi thi

verses.uthmani: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٖ مُّنقَعِرٖ
verses.indopak: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ ۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنْقَعِرٍ
verses.transliteration: tanzi'u alnnasa kaannahum a'jazu nakhlin munqa'irin
verses.saheeh: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.khattab: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
verses.jalalayn: ﻿tearing people away, wrenching them from the holes in the ground in which they had been embedded and flinging them down [to the ground] head first, thereby crushing their necks and severing [their] heads from [their] bodies, as if they were, [while lying] in this mentioned state, trunks of uprooted palm-trees, severed and thrown on the ground — they are likened to palm-trees because of their tallness (nakhlun, ‘palm-trees’, is masculine here but feminine in [sūrat] al-Hāqqa, nakhlun khāwiya, ‘fallen down [or hollow] palm-trees’, [Q. 69:7], in order to harmonise with the end-rhyme of the verses in both instances).
verses.romanUrdu: Jaise woh jadd (roots) se ukhade huey khajoor ke taney (trunks) hon

verses.uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kana 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿How then were My chastisement and My warnings?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas dekhlo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambihaat (warnings)

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have made the Qur'an easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, phir kya hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.indopak: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُوْدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
verses.saheeh: Thamud denied the warning
verses.khattab: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thamūd denied the warnings (nudhur is the plural of nadhīr, with the sense of mundhir), that is to say, [they denied] those matters which their prophet Sālih warned them of if they refused to believe in him and to follow him,
verses.romanUrdu: Samood ne tambihaat ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرٗا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدٗا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذٗا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.indopak: فَقَالُـوْۤا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗۤ ۙ اِنَّاۤ اِذًا لَّفِىْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ
verses.transliteration: faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabi'uhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasu'urin
verses.saheeh: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.khattab: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and they said, ‘Is it a mortal (basharan is in the accusative because it is governed [by a succeeding verb]) alone among us (minnā wāhidan are both adjectives of basharan) that we are to follow? (nattabi‘uhu, this explains the verb which renders it [basharan, ‘mortal’] accusative; the interrogative is meant as a negative, in other words: why should we follow him when there are many of us and he is only one among us and not a king? That is to say, we will not follow him). Then indeed, if we were to follow him, we would be in error, a parting with reason, and insanity!
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kehne lagey “Ek akela aadmi jo hum hi mein se hai kya ab hum uske peechey chalein? Iska ittibaah hum qabool karlein to iske maani yeh hongey ke hum behak gaye hain aur hamari aqal maari gayi hai

verses.uthmani: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٞ
verses.indopak: ءَاُلْقِىَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
verses.transliteration: aolqiya alththikru 'alayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
verses.saheeh: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
verses.khattab: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Has the Reminder, the revelation, been cast (read a-ulqiya pronouncing both hamzas, or by not pronouncing the second one but in both cases inserting an intervening alif, or leaving this [insertion] out) upon him [alone] from among us?, in other words, nothing has been revealed to him. Nay, but he is a conceited, an arrogant and insolent, liar, in his saying that the mentioned has been revealed to him. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Kya hamare darmiyan bas yahi ek shaks tha jispar khuda ka zikr nazil kiya gaya? nahin, balke yeh parle darje ka jhoota aur bar-khud galat (insolent liar)hai”

verses.uthmani: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدٗا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
verses.indopak: سَيَعْلَمُوْنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْاَشِرُ
verses.transliteration: saya'lamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
verses.saheeh: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
verses.khattab: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘They will know tomorrow, in the Hereafter, who is the conceited liar, and it is them, for they will be chastised for having denied their prophet Sālih.
verses.romanUrdu: (Humne apne paigambar se kaha) “ Kal hi inhein maaloom hua jata hai ke kaun parle darje ka jhoota aur bar khud galat hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةٗ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ ۖ
verses.transliteration: inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verses.khattab: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! We are sending the She-camel, We will bring it forth out of the mountain, the rock, as they demanded, as a trial, a test, for them, that We may try them. So watch them, O Sālih, await [to see] what they will do and what will be done with them, and remain patient (istabir: the tā’ here has replaced the tā’ of [the 8th form] ifta‘ala), in other words, endure their harm.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum ountni (she-camel) ko inke liye fitna bana kar bhej rahe hain, ab zara sabr ke saath dekh ke inka kya anjaam hota hai

verses.uthmani: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبٖ مُّحۡتَضَرٞ
verses.indopak: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۤءَ قِسْمَةٌ ۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.transliteration: wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
verses.saheeh: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.khattab: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And inform them that the water is to be divided between them, and the She-camel: one day for them and the next for it, every drinking, [every] portion of water, will be attended’, by the people [drawing water] on their [designated] day, and by the She-camel on its day. They adhered to this [regime] but eventually became impatient with it and decided to slaughter the She-camel.
verses.romanUrdu: Inko jata de ke paani inke aur ountni(she-camel) ke darmiyaan takseem hoga aur har ek apni baari ke din paani par aayega”

verses.uthmani: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.indopak: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطٰى فَعَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: fanadaw sahibahum fata'ata fa'aqara
verses.saheeh: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
verses.khattab: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they called their companion, Qudār, to slay it, so he took, he drew his sword, and he hamstrung, with it the She-camel, in other words, he slew her in compliance with their wish.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir-e-kaar un logon ne apne aadmi ko pukara aur usne is kaam ka beda uthaya aur ountni (she-camel) ko maar dala

verses.uthmani: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: fakayfa kana 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.khattab: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿How then were My chastisement and My warnings?, My warning them of chastisement before it was sent down? In other words, it was justified. He explains it [their chastisement] by saying:
verses.romanUrdu: Phir dekh lo ke kaisa tha mera azaab aur kaisi thi meri tambeehat (warnings)

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْا كَهَشِيْمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.transliteration: inna arsalna 'alayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We unleashed upon them a single Cry, and they became like the chaff of a corral builder (al-muhtazir is one who makes a pen from dried tree-branches and thorns for his sheep, to protect them from wolves and beasts of prey; the fallen parts which they tread are called hashīm).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne unpar bas ek hi dhamaka chodha aur woh baade wale ki rondhi hui baad ke taraah bhus ho kar reh gaya. (Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have made the Qur'an easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, ab hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.indopak: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ  بِۢالنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
verses.saheeh: The people of Lot denied the warning.
verses.khattab: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The people of Lot denied the warnings, [they denied] those issues of which they were warned by his [Lot’s] tongue.
verses.romanUrdu: Lut ki qaum ne tambihat ko jhutlaya

verses.uthmani: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٖ ۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوْطٍ ۗ نَّجَّيْنٰهُمْ بِسَحَرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna arsalna 'alayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
verses.khattab: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed We unleashed upon them a squall of pebbles, a wind hurling at them pebbles, namely, small stones, a single one [of these] being no larger than the palm of the hand, and they were destroyed; [all] except the family of Lot, namely, his two daughters, together with him, whom We delivered at dawn, from among the dawns, the morning time of an unspecified day (had a specific day been meant [for that mentioned dawn], it [sahar] would have been treated as a diptote [instead of the declined form saharin], being a definite noun derived from al-sahar, for with definite nouns one ought to use [the preceding definite article] al). So was the squall unleashed at first with the family of Lot [still there]? There are two opinions regarding this: in the case of the former [that it was unleashed upon them including the family of Lot] the exception is understood as a continuous one, while in the case of the latter [opinion that they were delivered before the squall] the exception is understood as a discontinuous one, even if it [‘the family of Lot’] is actually subsumed by the collective noun [‘the people of Lot’, and so they were delivered] as a kindness [from God];
verses.romanUrdu: Aur humne pattharao karne wali hawa is par bhej di. Sirf Lut ke ghar wale ussey mehfooz rahe

verses.uthmani: نِّعۡمَةٗ مِّنۡ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
verses.indopak: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَا ۗ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِىْ مَنْ شَكَرَ
verses.transliteration: ni'matan min 'indina kathalika najzee man shakara
verses.saheeh: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
verses.khattab: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿as a grace (ni‘matan is a verbal noun, that is to say in‘āman, ‘an act of grace’) from Us. So, like that requital, do We requite him who gives thanks, for Our graces and is a believer, or [it means] him who is a believer in God and His messenger and is obedient to both.
verses.romanUrdu: Unko humne apne fazl se raat ke pichle pehar bacha kar nikal diya. Yeh jaza dete hai hum har us shaks ko jo shukar guzar hota hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ اَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَـنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
verses.transliteration: walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
verses.saheeh: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
verses.khattab: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily he had warned them, Lot had threatened them, of Our strike, Our seizing them with chastisement, but they disputed, they contested and denied, the warnings, his warning.
verses.romanUrdu: Lut ne apni qaum ke logon ko hamari pakad se khabardaar kiya magar woh saari tambihat ko mashkuk (doubtful) samajh kar baaton mein udate rahey

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوْهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهٖ فَطَمَسْنَاۤ اَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: walaqad rawadoohu 'an dayfihi fatamasna a'yunahum fathooqoo 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
verses.khattab: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they had even solicited of him his guests, that he should let them have their own way with those who had come to him as guests, that they may do wicked things with them — and these [guests] were angels. So We blotted out their eyes, We blinded them and made them without slits [so that they were continuous folds of skin] like the rest of the face, by having Gabriel smack them with his wing. ‘So taste [now], so We said to them: taste, My chastisement and My warnings’, that is to say, [taste] the effects and the substance of My warning and My threat.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir unhon ne usey apne mehmano ki hifazat se baaz rakhne ki koshish ki. Aakhir-e-kaar humne unki aankhein moond-di (blinded), ke chakkho ab mera azaab aur meri tambihaat ka maza

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad sabbahahum bukratan 'athabun mustaqirrun
verses.saheeh: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
verses.khattab: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily there greeted them in the early morning, the morning time of an unspecified day, an abiding chastisement, a permanent [chastisement], continuous with the chastisement of the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Subah sawerey hi ek atal azaab ne unko aa liya

verses.uthmani: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
verses.indopak: فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِىْ وَنُذُرِ
verses.transliteration: fathooqoo 'athabee wanuthuri
verses.saheeh: So taste My punishment and warning.
verses.khattab: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘So taste [now] My chastisement and My warnings!’
verses.romanUrdu: Chakkho mazaa ab mere azaab ka aur meri tambihaat ka

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have made the Qur'an easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?
verses.romanUrdu: Humne is Quran ko nasihat ke liye aasaan zariya bana diya hai, pas hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad jaa ala fir'awna alnnuthuru
verses.saheeh: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
verses.khattab: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily there came to Pharaoh’s folk, his people, together with him, the warnings, the warning by the tongue of Moses and Aaron, but they did not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aal-e-Firoun ke paas bhi tambihaat aayi thi

verses.uthmani: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزٖ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
verses.indopak: كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ اَخْذَ عَزِيْزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha 'azeezin muqtadirin
verses.saheeh: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
verses.khattab: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Rather: They denied Our signs, all, nine, of them, which were given to Moses. So We seized them, by way of chastisement, with the seizing of One [Who is] Mighty, Strong, Omnipotent, Powerful, Whom nothing can thwart.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar unhon ne hamari saari nishaniyon ko jhutla diya. Aakhir ko humne unhein pakda jis taraah koi zabardast qudrat wala pakadta hai

verses.uthmani: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٞ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.indopak: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اُولٰۤٮِٕكُمْ اَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاۤءَةٌ فِى الزُّبُرِ ۚ
verses.transliteration: akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
verses.saheeh: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
verses.khattab: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Are your disbelievers, O Quraysh, better than those?, mentioned [beginning] from the people of Noah to those of Pharaoh, which is why they have not been chastised? Or have you, O disbelievers of Quraysh, [been granted] some immunity, from chastisement, in the Scriptures?, the Books? (the interrogative in both instances is meant as a denial, in other words: it is not so).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumhare kuffar kuch un logon se behtar hain? Ya aasmani kitaabon mein tumhare liye koi maafi likhi hui hai

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعٞ مُّنتَصِرٞ
verses.indopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ نَحْنُ جَمِيْعٌ مُّنْتَصِرٌ
verses.transliteration: am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'un muntasirun
verses.saheeh: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
verses.khattab: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they, the disbelievers of Quraysh, say: ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’?, against Muhammad (s)? When Abū Jahl, on the day of Badr, said: ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’, the following was revealed:
verses.romanUrdu: Ya in logon ka kehna yeh hai ke hum ek mazboot jattha (jamaat) hain, apna bachao kar lengey

verses.uthmani: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.indopak: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّوْنَ الدُّبُرَ
verses.transliteration: sayuhzamu aljam'u wayuwalloona alddubura
verses.saheeh: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
verses.khattab: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The host will [truly] be routed and turn its back [to flee], and so they were defeated at Badr and God’s Messenger (s) was granted victory over them.
verses.romanUrdu: Ankareeb yeh jattha(jamaat) shikhast kha jayega aur yeh sab peeth pheir kar bhaagte nazar aayenge

verses.uthmani: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.indopak: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدْهٰى وَاَمَرُّ
verses.transliteration: bali alssa'atu maw'iduhum waalssa'atu adha waamarru
verses.saheeh: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
verses.khattab: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but the Hour is their tryst, for chastisement, and the Hour, that is, the chastisement thereat, will be more calamitous, greater in affliction, and more bitter, than the chastisement of this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Balke insey nimatne ke liye asal waade ka waqt to qayamat hai aur woh badi aafat aur zyaada talkh-saa-at (badi sakht aur kadwi cheez) hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ وَسُعُرٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ ۘ
verses.transliteration: inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasu'urin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed the guilty are in error, in the destruction of being killed in this world, and in a blazing fire, a fire that has been set ablaze (musa‘‘ara), that is, fiercely ignited in the Hereafter.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh mujrim log dar haqeeqat galat fehmi mein mubtala hain aur inki aqal maari gayi hai

verses.uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.indopak: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُوْنَ فِى النَّارِ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْ ۗ ذُوْقُوْا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.transliteration: yawma yushaboona fee alnnari 'ala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
verses.saheeh: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
verses.khattab: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces, in the Hereafter and it is said to them: ‘Taste [now] the touch of Saqar’, Hell’s affliction of you.
verses.romanUrdu: Jis roz yeh mooh ke bal aag mein ghaseetey jayenge us roz insey kaha jayega ke ab chakkho jahannum ki lapat ka maza

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.transliteration: inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly everything (read inna kulla shay’in is [in the accusative as a] dependent clause because of a verb governing it) have We created in a measure, by ordainment (bi-qadarin, ‘in a measure’, is a circumstantial qualifier referring to kulla, ‘every’, in other words, ‘[already] predetermined’; a variant reading [for kulla] has [nominative] kullu as the subject, the predicate of which is khalaqnāhu, ‘We have created’).
verses.romanUrdu: Humne har cheez ek taqdeer ke saath paida ki hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٞ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
verses.indopak: وَمَاۤ اَمْرُنَاۤ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِۢالْبَصَرِ
verses.transliteration: wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
verses.saheeh: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
verses.khattab: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Our command, for a thing which We want to bring into existence, is but a single word, like the twinkling of an eye, in terms of speed, and this is the saying of kun, ‘Be’, whereat it comes into existence. His command, when He wills a thing, is just to say to it ‘Be’, and it is [Q. 36:82].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur hamara hukum bas ek hi hukum hota hai aur palak jhapakate (twinkling of an eye) woh amal mein aa jata hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرٖ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ اَهْلَـكْنَاۤ اَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.transliteration: walaqad ahlakna ashya'akum fahal min muddakirin
verses.saheeh: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
verses.khattab: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We have destroyed the likes of you, the likes of you in terms of disbelief, from among past communities. So is there anyone who will remember? (this is an interrogative meant as an imperative, that is to say, ‘Remember and be admonished!’).
verses.romanUrdu: Tum jaisey bahut-soon ko hum halak kar chuke hain. Phir hai koi nasihat qabool karne wala

verses.uthmani: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٖ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.indopak: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوْهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ
verses.transliteration: wakullu shayin fa'aloohu fee alzzuburi
verses.saheeh: And everything they did is in written records.
verses.khattab: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And everything they, that is, servants, have done is, recorded, in the scrolls, the books of the Guardian Angels (al-hafaza),
verses.romanUrdu: Jo kuch inhon ne kiya hai woh sab daftaron (office) mein darj hai

verses.uthmani: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
verses.indopak: وَ كُلُّ صَغِيْرٍ وَّكَبِيْرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.transliteration: wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
verses.saheeh: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
verses.khattab: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and every small and great, sin, or deed, is inscribed, is recorded in the Preserved Tablet (al-lawh al-mahfūz).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur har choti badi baat likhi hui maujood hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِىْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
verses.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly the God-fearing will be amid gardens, orchards, and rivers (the collective noun is meant here; a variant reading [for nahar] has the plural nuhur, similar [in form] to asad, ‘lion’, [plural] usud), the meaning being that they will drink from its rivers water milk, honey and wine;
verses.romanUrdu: Nafarmani se parhez karne waley yaqeenan baaghon aur neharon mein hongey

verses.uthmani: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
verses.indopak: فِىْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيْكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.transliteration: fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda maleekin muqtadirin
verses.saheeh: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
verses.khattab: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in an abode of truth, a place of truth, wherein there is no idle talk or cause for sin — (the collective noun [maq‘ad] is meant here; a variant reading has maqā‘id, ‘abodes’), in other words, they are in congregations in Paradise that are free from idle talk and cause for sin, in contrast to the congregations of this world, which are rarely free from such things (syntactically, this statement is considered a second predicate and also a substitution; it [the ‘abode’] may be understood as being ‘one of truth’ regardless of whether one reads the substitution as being of the part [for the whole] or otherwise); before a King (malīk: this form is hyperbolic, that is to say, One of a mighty and vast kingdom) [Who is] Omnipotent, Powerful, Whom nothing can thwart, namely, God, exalted be He (‘inda indicates [glorious] rank and closeness to His bounty, exalted be He).
verses.romanUrdu: Sacchi izzat ki jagah, badey zeeh-iqtedar baadshah ke kareeb
